scripts.build: pnpm --filter @chess/core build && pnpm --filter @chess/domain build && pnpm --filter client build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @chess/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @chess/domain typecheck && pnpm --filter client exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @chess/core test && pnpm --filter @chess/domain test && pnpm --filter client test
scripts.test:watch: pnpm --filter @chess/core test:watch && pnpm --filter @chess/domain test:watch && pnpm --filter client test:watch
scripts.format: pnpm --filter @chess/core format && pnpm --filter @chess/domain format && pnpm --filter client format
scripts.format:check: pnpm --filter @chess/core format:check && pnpm --filter @chess/domain format:check && pnpm --filter client format:check
